scope: MEAS: independent numerical, published bar-map, provenance, report and visual review; not aural review.

resolution.finding: The listening owner replaced the obsolete 46-second return inference with nine resolving bar anchors, corrected section timing, qualified the changed final pickup and removed the incorrect nineteen-second strain estimate. First B is bar 17/1 at 33.637 s; returning bar 9/2 is 52.546 s after its 51.825 s pickup; second B is bar 17/2 at 69.369 s. The initial repeat-cue contradiction is resolved without changing the passing audio score.

report.finding: The per-piece report agrees with recomputed gates, 42 occurrences / 673 notes / 81 quarter units, partial-bar return, source licence and real pickup packaging. It appropriately labels the performed order as inferred and the timing as provisional.

barMap.finding: Actual SVG/index bars are 0–24, including real pickup glyphs in bar 0. Score order is 0–24, then the last 0.5 quarter of bar 8 and bars 9–24. All 673 note indices resolve, durations are positive, and bar occurrence times strictly increase. The single engraved page was visually inspected. All six bar-anchored cues and three transition anchors resolve to exactly one published bar occurrence and agree with the corrected repeat description.

overlays.finding: No gross pitch/order mismatch identified. Both A and B returns have corresponding melodic/bass contours; no second compressed A cycle is required on the return. Earlier coarse 46-second return inference is superseded by this evidence.

version.finding: Original piano scoring with AABAB performed order: source writes A+A+B, followed here by the returning pickup and A+B rather than a complete second A+A+B traversal. Source staff aggregation does not identify separately recovered performed voices.
version.physicalPerformingEdition: Unknown; the source edition is identified, not claimed as Donald Betts’s performing copy.

limitations: MEAS: No aural review, build or browser integration check was performed by VerS. The source, inferred performed order and timing remain explicitly provisional.
